files.README.md:
# Barrowbeck Water Trust - trunk mains

Shared folder for the operations room.

- mains/  cards for each trunk main
- valves/  records from the valve gang

turns.prompt: An inspector new to Barrowbeck Water Trust asked what static head means on a main card; it is the drop in level from the water surface in the reservoir down to the outlet, and each metre of that drop adds 9.81 kilopascals at the outlet. Main M-7 draws from a reservoir whose surface sits at 96 metres, with its outlet at 66 metres. Give the pressure the head puts on the outlet in kilopascals.
